text:
Tess (PM): Quick decision: compact ledger or mixed cards for billing page? Need to prioritize invoice discoverability.
Ravi (Design): Compact ledger preferred for scanning. We can keep a sticky top "Download invoice (PDF)" CTA.
Noelle (Frontend): Sticky CTA is easy. Per-row CSV downloads fine but must avoid tab bloat. Use roving tabindex.
Finn (Analytics): Data: header downloads outperform row downloads by 2x. Keep header primary.
Ravi (Design): Also propose a small 40px sparkline column and a token/USD segmented control in the header.
ux-bot: Accessibility reminder: segmented control must have aria-checked/role and 4.5:1 contrast. Add aria-live for scope updates.
Tess (PM): Action items: Ravi update mocks (8px row spacing), Noelle prototype keyboard nav, Finn validate header CTA copy. Review in tomorrow's 30-min crit.
Noelle (Frontend): Noted. I'll prototype canvas sparklines to keep DOM light.
Tess (PM): Thanks, closing thread.
